# hush_statsig_access_credential (Resource)

Manage Statsig dynamic access credentials in the Hush Security platform. The access manager mints a server or client SDK key per policy with a Console API key, and deletes it on rotation. Statsig takes up to about five minutes to accept a new key. Needs hush-am 0.34.1 or later on the deployment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Create a Statsig dynamic access credential from a Console API key with the
# omni_read_write and can_access_keys scopes
resource "hush_statsig_access_credential" "example" {
  name           = "prod-statsig"
  description    = "Production Statsig project"
  deployment_ids = [hush_deployment.example.id]

  api_key_wo         = var.statsig_console_api_key
  api_key_wo_version = "1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_ids` (List of String) List of deployment IDs that can access this credential. Currently limited to a single deployment. Changing this after creation is not supported; the credential must be deleted and recreated.
- `name` (String) The name of the Statsig access credential

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) A Statsig Console API key with the `omni_read_write` and `can_access_keys` scopes
- `api_key_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) A Statsig Console API key with the `omni_read_write` and `can_access_keys` scopes (write-only). More secure than `api_key` because Terraform will not store this value in the state file.
- `api_key_wo_version` (String) Used to trigger updates for `api_key_wo`. Change when the API key changes.
- `description` (String) The description of the Statsig access credential
- `secret_store_id` (String) The ID of the secret store where this credential is saved (optional)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the Statsig access credential
- `kind` (String) The kind of access credential
- `type` (String) The type of access credential
